PAYLOAD='{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"capabilities":{}}}'
CONTENT_LENGTH=$(echo -n "$PAYLOAD" | wc -c)

printf "Content-Length: $CONTENT_LENGTH\r\n\r\n$PAYLOAD" | nc cuepls 4001
